assertions.property: drain_due && ref_count > 0 |-> $past(mvalid && mready && ref_count > 0) && mdata == ref_expected
assertions.reason: Ensures that at a fair-drain checkpoint, if there are outstanding accepted inputs, the last output must match the oldest outstanding input. This complements the existing property by focusing on the condition where the drain is due and there are outstanding inputs.
Ensures that the output data (mdata) remains stable during backpressure (mready is low) across consecutive cycles, as required by the stall_stability obligation.

The new assertion checks that every accepted output corresponds to the current oldest accepted, uncancelled input. It ensures that reset cancels all pending inputs and that a cancelled payload does not reappear. The assertion is triggered on the output acceptance edge and checks the existence and identity of the output.

The previous predicate did not correctly distinguish between legal and faulty traces. The new predicate ensures that the output remains valid and stable during backpressure, as required by the stall_stability obligation.
